notes: 今天 can act as a noun (the day of today) or an adverb (happening on this day). In sentences like '今天很热' (Today is hot), it functions as the topic or subject of the sentence.
Do not confuse this with '现在' (xiàn zài), which means 'now' and refers specifically to the current moment rather than the entire 24-hour day.
